Installing a lower version code over the Play build needs `adb install -r -d` |\n\nTwo facts the probes produced that the plan did not predict:\n- **Launching `VoiceInputActivity` makes Chrome hide its keyboard** (`ImeTracker: onRequestHide at\n  ORIGIN_CLIENT reason HIDE_SOFT_INPUT`). The bubble therefore starts the owner DIRECTLY from the\n  accessibility service, which works on stock Android 16 with the microphone foreground service; the\n  activity remains the fallback when the direct start is refused. The side button and the tile still\n  launch the activity and still close the keyboard, as before.\n- **Any package install reconnects the accessibility service**: `onServiceConnected` fires again on the\n  same instance. Codex installing its onboarding preview on the SHARED emulator did this mid-take. The\n  overlay is now created once per instance, and a second agent gets its own AVD: two emulators run side by\n  side on the Mac (`-port 5554` and `-port 5556`).\n\nThe probe shape: read the bubble's box from `dumpsys window windows` (`mAttrs={(x,y)(wxh)`), tap or\nswipe its centre with `input`, speak with `say -r 170 \"<sentence>\"` through the Mac speaker, and read the\noutcome from `logcat -s DictationSession PasteService AsrService` plus the window list again. Reset the\ndock with `run-as com.envi.wispr rm shared_prefs/lips_bubble_position.xml` and `am kill com.envi.wispr`.\n\n## FACT: the-earbud-colour-uat\nThe blue earbud lips (#171, build 140, founder pass 2026-09-18 \"yes works great\") are a phone-only check;\nthe emulator has no Bluetooth. Recipe: AirPods connected, Input device Auto, Messages with the keyboard\nup: the bubble lips are the blue rainbow; tap and speak: the tap pill's active bars are blue, grey at rest;\nhold and speak: the same on the hold pill; AirPods into the case: brand rainbow within a second; Settings,\npick Phone with AirPods in: brand; pick the AirPods by name: blue. Repeat the idle check in Bare over a\nwhite page, Clear and Smoke, docked left and right. Restore Input device to Auto. The colour's input is on\nlogcat as `PasteService: Bubble colour: inputs=N earbuds=true|false`; the History card's microphone\nline is the independent check of what recorded.\n\nWhat rung 1 on the Play AVD taught (2026-09-18): `WISPR_SERIAL=emulator-5554` points the harness at the\nemulator; the AVD unlock recipe lives in `../skills/wispr-eyes/SKILL.md` \"The emulator\"; a `data:` URL\nhanded to `am start` is re-parsed by the device shell, and Chrome refuses `file:///sdcard/...`\n(`ERR_ACCESS_DENIED`), so the editor is Gmail compose through the harness (`tap('Compose',\npackage='com.google.android.gm')` then `focus_field('Compose email', 'com.google.android.gm')`);\ndiscard the draft afterwards through `More options` then `Discard`. `settings put secure\nenabled_accessibility_services \"\"` is \"Bad arguments\"; set the component directly.\n\n## FACT: the-microphone-swap-uat\nThe Mac-style swap (#173, build 142, founder pass 2026-09-18 \"ran the gambit - works great\") needs two\nheadsets, so it is phone-only. Recipe: pick the AirPods in Settings → AirPods off, Bose \"Storm\" on →\nMicrophone page: Auto selected, \"Using Storm\", no AirPods row → dictate: no AirPods line on the recorder\n(the one Bluetooth tip may show), History card \"Microphone: Storm\" → AirPods on: the AirPods row is back\nand selected → tap Storm; AirPods on: AirPods listed, not selected (the memory was replaced) → both off:\nAuto, \"Using Phone\" → leave and reopen Settings: rows right on open → tap the already-selected Auto row,\nStorm on: Auto stays (memory gone). Oracle: the rows by eye and the History card's microphone line; on\nlogcat `AudioCapture: route start=<device> ... reason=PICKED|AUTO|PICK_MISSING` says what the take chose.\n\nTwo connection lessons from that run. The phone's log keeps about an hour (`logcat -G` is capped at 5 MiB\non the S26), so a finding reported later than that has no log: start `adb logcat -v time AudioCapture:V\nDictationSession:V AsrService:V PasteService:V '*:S' > <file>` on the Mac in the background BEFORE the\nfounder's run. And after Wireless debugging is re-enabled the phone can appear only as an mDNS serial\n(`adb-R5GL11DR0EZ-…._adb-tls-connect._tcp`, sometimes with a ` (N)` suffix, so match it with a pattern):\n`adb -s \"<that serial>\" tcpip 5555` then `adb connect 100.94.206.47:5555` normalises it; the four ports\n`nmap` shows open on the phone were not adbd.\n\n## FACT: the-insertion-uat-matrix\nUnit tests and the paste-target fixture cannot close the insertion contract. The matrix, driven by the\nside button with Gboard the default keyboard: a plain field (Messages); a rich editor (Gmail, Google\nDocs); a browser field (Chrome address bar, a web form); a terminal or code editor; a chat app; a password\nfield, treated as ordinary by decision (`../rules/architecture-rules.md` FACT:\nthere-is-no-sensitive-field-guard-and-that-is-decided; until #11 lands it still diverts to copy-only, so\nthat row proves the OLD behaviour); a stale or unsupported target, which must keep the transcript on the\nclipboard and say so; and **back-to-back** (dictate, insert, immediately dictate again, asserting the\nsecond transcript reaches the editor), where the P1 lives (#132).\n\n## FACT: what-gmail-actually-does-to-insertion-2026-08-30\nMeasured on the S26 from the founder's own dictations. Four symptoms, one cause.\n\n- **The insertion succeeds and is reported as unverified.** All 21 attempts logged `action=SET_TEXT\n  textMatched=true ... caret=0/0 expectedCaret=34`; the only failing clause in\n  `AccessibilityInsertionRules.isVerified` is the caret, because Gmail's compose reports `0/0` wherever\n  the insertion went. **The caret is NOT cosmetic, so do not drop it from the check**: it decides WHERE the\n  words go, and a `0/0` read puts them at the start of the field (\"it also sucks other text to it\").\n- **It destroys the user's whitespace.** `SET_TEXT` replaces the WHOLE field with a string composed from a\n  lossy read-back (`AccessibilityNodeInfo.text` normalises whitespace), so lines merge. Do NOT relax\n  `isVerified`; a check that accepted this ships silent data loss in real drafts.\n- **Why the destructive path was taken:** `normalizedSelection` returns `null` for `-1/-1` and the code\n  fell back to paste on that null, but Gmail reports `0/0`, a PLAUSIBLE value, not a sentinel\n  (`../rules/validation-discipline.md` FACT: silent-empty-traps). The log corroborates: `ACTION_SET_SELECTION`\n  to 34 followed by a read of `0/0`, so this editor reports no caret at all.\n- Closing and reopening Gmail fixes it, so the app works from a stale view of that editor.\n\nResolved by #141's one-route-one-write rule (commit route, then paste, no `ACTION_SET_TEXT`); the macOS\ncascade for comparison is `Sources/EnviousWisprPipeline/PasteCascadeExecutor.swift`, and the two shipping\ncompetitors neither check the caret nor rewrite a non-empty compose\n(`docs/internal/competitor-insertion-study.md`). **Reproducing it needs the founder's own hand:** every\nGmail compose opened over ADB reported `NO_PINNED_TARGET`, so two runs are comparable only when the\neditor was opened the same way.\n\n## FACT: the-141-one-write-emulator-uat\nRun 2026-09-13 on `emulator-5554` (`EnviousWispr_Android_16`, Gboard, Chrome, host mic on). Editor: a\nlocal page from the Mac (`http://10.0.2.2:8765`) with a `<textarea>` holding two paragraphs and a blank\nline, and a mirror `<pre>` showing `JSON.stringify(value)`. Oracle: the mirror, never the clipboard or log.\n\nChunk 1 (debug build of `feat/141-insertion-cascade` at `52ef940`, paste only): two takes, both `route=PASTE ...\noutcome=VERIFIED` (attempts 2 then 14, the second because Chrome's node lagged the paste), blank line\nintact, each sentence once at the caret with the seam space. Capitals and the trailing period come from\nthe cleanup limb. `Clipboard changed during insertion; preserving the newer clipboard` after a success is\n`ClipboardService: Denying clipboard access ... not in focus` (the Android 10+ background read limit), so\nthe user's previous clip is not restored.\n\nChunk 2 (`feat/141-commit-route` at `2fe39dc`, voice through the cable): four dictations, every line\n`route=COMMIT written=true returned=VOID outcome=VERIFIED` (caret after \"Hi team,\", end of draft,\nmid-draft right after an `adb install -r`, and a short mid-draft take with `evidence=SURROUNDING`), no\nclipboard write, seam and capital right. Log shapes: `Input started on the pipe: package=... restarting=true`\nat every focus change; `Commit route not eligible: <reason>` (`no input method`, `input not started`,\n`session package differs`, `focused window differs`, `pinned editor not focused`) when paste is taken;\n`The pipe read surrounding text: before=<n> after=<n> offset=<n>`. Chrome answers `offset=-1` (unknown), so\na window shorter than the compare length hands over to the node judge (`evidence=NODE`), while a payload\nshort enough for the window verifies by the windows (`evidence=SURROUNDING`). The service's own `withPinnedNode` proof is the\neligibility test, not a FOCUS_INPUT search from the window root. NOT RUN: Gmail on this AVD, Messages, the S26.\n\n## FACT: the-play-store-emulator-for-gmail-and-chatgpt\nA second AVD `EnviousWispr_Android_16_Play` (2026-09-13): `pixel_9_pro_xl` on\n`system-images;android-36;google_apis_playstore;arm64-v8a`, `PlayStore.enabled=yes`, `hw.ramSize=4096`,\n`hw.keyboard=yes`. Launch: `EW_AVD_NAME=EnviousWispr_Android_16_Play bash scripts/enviouswispr-emulator.sh`;\nboth AVDs use `emulator-5554`, so run ONE at a time. Signed in as `hello@enviouslabs.co` (screen lock PIN\n`1234`), Gmail synced, ChatGPT installed, Parakeet placed by hand, S1-mini pulled by onboarding.\n\n- **Open Gmail compose with the app's own Compose button** (`ComposeActivityGmail`); a `mailto:` intent\n  opens `ComposeActivityGmailExternal`, whose body discovery does NOT see (`Bubble discovery found=false`),\n  which an earlier session misread as \"the emulator cannot test Gmail\".\n- **Compose survives a settings round trip only through BACK:** `am start -n\n  com.envi.wispr/.ui.SettingsActivity` on top of Gmail, tap, then `KEYCODE_BACK` twice; any intent aimed\n  at Gmail pops the compose to the conversation (draft saved; reopen with the pencil).\n- **Under a host load average above 50 the first `injectAudio` take can decode as silence** (`textChars=0`,\n  recogniser init 83 s); check `uptime` before blaming the mic or the build.\n- Gmail UAT 2026-09-13 (`feat/141-commit-route` at `1277d9f`): one commit at the caret, `route=COMMIT ...\n  outcome=VERIFIED attempts=1 ms=66 target=com.google.android.gm`, no clipboard write; Gmail answers\n  `getSurroundingText` with `offset=-1`, so `evidence=NODE`. The Mac `say` voice mis-hears words; the\n  oracle is placement, seam and capital.\n\n## RULE: feed-emulator-audio-over-grpc-injectaudio-not-blackhole\n**Canonical way to feed spoken audio to the emulator, reliable back-to-back (proven 2026-09-13, #141):**\nstream PCM into the virtual mic over the emulator gRPC `injectAudio` RPC, bypassing coreaudio and\nBlackHole. Since #177 (2026-09-20) the harness owns every step: `launch_emulator()` (boots with `-grpc\n8554`), `set_host_mic(False)` (over gRPC, journaled), `inject_audio(pcm)` inside `open_recorder()`,\n`dictate_emulator(sentence)` for one take judged by the editor's text; the loose scripts are gone. On top\nof it, `scripts/uat/rail_signals.py` (#151, 2026-09-15): known sounds (silence, three tones, a sweep, hiss, 4 Hz\nbursts) injected during a take, the pill screen-recorded, every bar measured per frame from its pixels\nand judged against what the rail must draw. It found the tap pill's mapping skipping five of eleven bands\nwhile the published picture was right, which no spoken take could have shown. Two traps it met: with the\nhost microphone off the emulator's own source ramps up for about a second after the microphone opens\n(it lit every bar on a rate-limited noise floor, so the floor became a windowed minimum), and a hold is\ndriven with `input swipe x y x y <ms>` on the bubble while the packets stream.\n\n- **Emulator 37.2.8+ (canary, `sdkmanager --channel=3 emulator`).** 37.1.11 crashes on the SECOND\n  recording of a session (`coreaudio: Could not initialize record`) on both paths. **After upgrading the\n  binary you MUST `-wipe-data` on next boot** (old userdata makes every activity unresolvable); that\n  erases the AVD, so budget the re-setup.\n- **Launch with `-grpc 8554`** (console port + 3000; unauthenticated on localhost). Client: `grpcurl`\n  (brew); proto at `~/Android/sdk/emulator/lib/emulator_controller.proto`, service\n  `android.emulation.control.EmulatorController`.\n- **Host mic OFF is the emulator's RESTING state, and nothing switches it inside a take.** A capture\n  opened right after a host-mic switch dropped the injected audio 4 times in 25 (`Transcription result\n  received (chars=0)`, `NO_SPEECH`); 0 in 10 with no switch inside the take (2026-09-20, #181). The\n  mechanism is the emulator's. `launch_emulator()`, `dictate_emulator()` and the BlackHole take's cleanup\n  all call `_rest_host_mic_off()`; gRPC `setMicrophoneState` flips the same switch the old console\n  command did and `getMicrophoneState` READS it, so the console is not used.\n- **Per take, in order** (what `dictate_emulator()` does): rest the mic off (usually already off);\n  `open_recorder()` (the mic must be open or injectAudio resets); wait ~3 s; `inject_audio(pcm)`; stop.\n  Half a second of silence is appended to the PCM, or the last word is cut (\"to Ma.\" for \"tomorrow\",\n  first live take 2026-09-20).\n- **PCM + packets:** s16le mono 48000 Hz raw; `inject_audio` is the ONLY packet builder: newline-delimited\n  JSON AudioPackets of ~100 ms (9600 bytes), each with a `format` block AND a `timestamp` (epoch us;\n  empty crashed the emulator); `MODE_UNSPECIFIED`.\n\n**BlackHole is the fallback only:** one take per boot; never switch the Mac's default input while the\nemulator runs; `hostmicon` once at boot, never per take; never run another recorder on BlackHole.\n\n## FACT: silent-physical-phone-audio-injection-for-night-uat\nThe physical-phone counterpart to the emulator gRPC path, and the DEFAULT way to run a real take on the\nS26 without speaker sound (founder wants night UAT while the household sleeps). Owner:\n`scripts/uat/silent-audio/` (`README.md` is the contract, `run.py` the one call, `SilentAudio.java` the\n`app_process` injector). It feeds the test PCM through an `AudioPolicy` `REMOTE_SUBMIX` injection mix\nscoped to `com.envi.wispr`'s UID; the authorized ADB shell already holds the routing permission, so there\nis no APK change, no root, no volume change, and no audio leaves the phone. Media volume is asserted\nunchanged; it never touches a speaker track.\n\nOne call, into an already focused empty editor on the unlocked phone:\n```bash\npython3 scripts/uat/silent-audio/run.py --serial 100.94.206.47:5555 \\\n  --pcm /data/local/tmp/<fixture>.pcm --expect '<exact editor text>' --receipt /tmp/<dir>\n```\nFixture is raw 16 kHz mono s16le PCM already ON THE PHONE, rendered SILENTLY (Azure TTS to PCM, or\n`say`+`ffmpeg` per `README.md`), never recorded from the phone.\n\n- **Gotcha: do NOT `adb logcat -c` right before the run.** `run.py`'s precondition reads the log for a\n  prior recording start/stop; an empty log blocks it (`the log holds neither the start nor the end of a\n  take`). Seed one benign start/stop first (toggle the recorder on the home screen with no field focused:\n  `am start -n com.envi.wispr/.ui.VoiceInputActivity --ez toggle true` then `--ez stop true`).\n- **One phone, exclusive** while it runs; it drives the real exported recorder.\n- **After a Play update or a force-stop on Android 16 the enabled service stays UNBOUND until the app is\n  launched once** (`dumpsys accessibility`: named under `Enabled services`, absent from `Bound services`,\n  nothing under `Crashed services`); the write-empty-then-set dance alone did not bind it, `open_app` did\n  (measured 2026-09-21 on build 154). Launch the app, then check `bound()`.\n- **`restore()` with a journaled switch needs the app's own tab row on screen**: it re-reads the switch's\n  page, so from Gmail or Chrome it raises `the four tabs are not all on screen`. Open the app first\n  (`open_app('com.envi.wispr')`), then `restore()`; the emulator take helpers do this in their `finally`.\n- Verified 2026-09-16 on internal build 134 into a Chrome web input: 4/4 `route=COMMIT outcome=VERIFIED`,\n  ~130 ms, `attempts=2` (the pipe's re-read recovers on the second attempt), the editor's own text\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

Problem\n    20\tFifteen audit findings (2026-09-16) and the REF-09 comment (2026-09-20) name ways the harness and the device test can report success for a dictation that did not land where it should, or did not land at all. Gate 0 (issue comment 2026-09-22) re-read each against `scripts/uat/wispr_eyes.py` at b94a1e4 (3628 lines): still open are findings 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and REF-09; findings 1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 15 and sections B/C concern the speaker-playback path, dormant behind `RECORDING_IS_OFF` and superseded by #162.\n    21\t\n    22\t## 2. Goals & non-goals\n    23\t### 2.1 Goals\n    24\t- A `VERIFIED` line from `dictate_emulator` / `debug_insert` means: the same focused editor before and after; its whole text equals `before + expected`; the current take's `insertion api=` line says `outcome=VERIFIED written=true target=<package>`; the route is reported separately.\n    25\t- The harness's evidence is bounded to the take it owns; two takes in the window is `UNKNOWN`, never a pass.\n    26\t- Every recording-gated entry point answers `NOT RUN: recording from this harness is off …` before touching anything.\n    27\t- The device test learns the subject is done from the subject (phase writes, the History row), never from `Thread.sleep` or a logcat poll; it asserts the editor's own text, exactly once, the other editor untouched, and the stored route.\n    28\t- Dead harness code is deleted, not repaired.\n    29\t### 2.2 Non-goals\n    30\t- Turning recording on for the phone from the harness (`RECORDING_IS_OFF`): unchanged; the phone's take stays `scripts/uat/silent-audio/run.py`.\n    31\t- A windowless playback Service in the test APK (issue sections B/C): not built; #162's `REMOTE_SUBMIX` injector needs no APK change and already answers the windowless requirement.\n    32\t- Deleting `SpeakerPlaybackActivity` from the test APK: it is the audio fixture of `SilenceStoppedTakeTranscribesDeviceTest` (started at its line 69); only the HARNESS side that launched it goes. Its instrumentation callers are out of scope here (they do not sleep on a launch).\n    33\t- REF-02's injected settings/vocabulary failure rows on the device: no seam exists (`grep -rln 'FailOpen\\|failOpen\\|DebugFailure' app/src/main/java app/src/debug/java` → none) and a seam on a guard is a bypass (`validation-discipline.md` RULE: a-test-seam-on-a-GUARD-is-a-bypass); corrupting the founder's preference files is not a staging step. #193's JVM rows are the evidence; stated in §14.\n    34\t- A type-aware or DOM-identity check of a Chrome web field (finding 4's \"NOT VERIFIED\"): the editor identity stays resource id + bounds + package + focus, stated.\n    35\t\n    36\t## 2.5 Grounding brief\n    37\t\n    38\t### 1. Trace producer → owner → consumer, end to end\n    39\t- The take's evidence lines are produced by the app: `insertion api=… route=… written=… returned=… evidence=… outcome=… attempts=… ms=… overrun=… target=…` (read live 2026-09-22 on the emulator: `insertion api=36 route=COMMIT written=true returned=VOID evidence=SURROUNDING outcome=VERIFIED attempts=1 ms=54 overrun=false target=com.google.android.gm`); `DebugInsert: pin=… handoff=… textChars=…` (the debug receiver); `Stopped by <what>.`, `Transcription result received (chars=N)`, `(handoff=X)` (the owner). Consumers: `last_take()` (`wispr_eyes.py:2928`, still parses `Insertion completed via (\\w+)`, a line no producer writes: `grep -rn 'Insertion completed via' app/src` → zero hits), `dictate_emulator` (`:2586`, prints the `insertion api=` tail as a NOTE, gates nothing on it), `debug_insert` (`:2661`), `_wait_for_the_take_to_finish`, `recording()` (`:1460`).\n    40\t- The editor's text is produced by the editor and read by `_focused_field(package)` (`:3455`) through the fast eye / uiautomator tree: `(resource_id, bounds/identity, text)`; `dictate_emulator` compares `after[:2] != before[:2]` then `_sentence_landed(sentence, after[2])` (`:2539`, substring on `_plain`, capitalised variant tried).\n    41\t- Accessibility liveness: `dumpsys accessibility` → `bound()` (`:482`), regex `Bound services:\\{Service\\[label=EnviousWispr`. The dump on the emulator (captured 2026-09-22): `Bound services:{Service[label=EnviousWispr, feedbackType[…], …]}`; items are comma-separated inside one `{…}`; with another service bound first ours is not at the head. Consumers: `enable_auto_paste`, `dictate_emulator`, `debug_insert`, `ready()`.\n    42\t- The restore book: `~/.cache/wispr-eyes/restore.json`, keyed by the TRANSPORT serial (`_owe`/`_owed`/`_settled`, `:190-244`; the file today holds `100.94.206.47:5555`, `host`, `emulator-5554`). `ro.serialno` is read at `:389` for device selection only.\n    43\t- Recording gate: `_recording_is_off()` (`:276`); callers return `BLOCKED: {RECORDING_IS_OFF}` at `dictate_emulator:2595-2596` and three more (enumerated in §10). The skill (`.claude/skills/wispr-eyes/SKILL.md`) says `NOT RUN: recording from this harness is off`.\n    44\t- Device test signals: `DictationSurfaceState` writes `phase` into `SharedPreferences(\"dictation_surface_state\")` (`shortcuts/DictationSurfaceState.kt:14-15`); `aDictationWithNoFieldToInsertIntoIsNotReportedToTheUserAsAFailure` already waits on it with an `OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener` (`VoicePipelineDeviceTest.kt:252-283`). The insertion outcome is written to the History row (`TranscriptDao.finalizeInsertionOutcome`, `updateStatus(insertionResult=…)`; values `InsertionResults.COMMITTED|PASTED|CLIPBOARD|COPY_ONLY|…`, `insertion/InsertionResults.kt`), observable through `TranscriptDao.observeAll(): Flow<List<TranscriptEntity>>` (Room invalidation, subject-fired). The editor's receipt: `PasteTargetActivity` writes its whole text to `files/paste-target-received.txt` on every change (`PasteTargetActivity.kt:52-63`), an oracle the subject did not write.\n    45\t- `launcherRecordsPhonePlaybackAndReachesClipboardStep` (`:168-199`): `Thread.sleep(2_000)`, speaker playback with `Thread.sleep(clip length)`, a 30 s `logcat -d` poll for `Auto-insert handed` / `transcript kept on clipboard`, and asserts a polish engine name (`S1-mini by Superwhisper (NPU)`) that the emulator cannot produce.\n    46\t\n    47\t### 2. Find the existing authority before proposing one\n    48\t- The harness IS the authority for driving a device (`tools-and-apps.md` RULE: drive-the-phone-through-wispr-eyes-before-any-raw-adb); its journal is the restore authority; `run.py` is the phone's take authority (#162). Nothing new is invented: the verdict gates, the identity key and the screen recording are additions to existing functions.\n    49\t- For audio into an instrumented take there is no authority today: `VoicePipelineDeviceTest` plays a speaker itself. The harness already owns audio on both devices (`inject_audio` over gRPC; `run.py`'s injector), so the design makes the harness the audio driver for the device test too (D-T2).\n    50\t\n    51\t### 3. Read prior attempts and live direction\n    52\t- 2026-09-16: the audit queued here; `take-windowless.py` (the app_process dex hack) proved COMMIT on the phone; Codex said a test-APK Service should be the durable home. 2026-09-20: #162 shipped `run.py` (REMOTE_SUBMIX injection, no APK, silent, fail-closed), making the Service unnecessary; #177 removed Appium and made the harness the only door; #181 the fast eye. 2026-09-21/22: `dictate_emulator` proved COMMIT into Gmail on the emulator on every #115 and #194 run.\n    53\t- Founder direction: recording from the harness stays off on the phone until a review closes the class (`wispr_eyes.py:247-259`); night UAT on the phone is `run.py`.\n    54\t\n    55\t### 4. Name the lifecycle, trust and process boundaries a naive design would miss\n    56\t- Instrumentation runs in the APP process; `PasteTargetActivity` runs in the TEST package's process: the field's text crosses by the receipt FILE (already so). The History DB is in the app process: `observeAll()` works from the test.\n    57\t- The emulator cannot hear its own speaker; audio enters through the host (gRPC) or the phone's injector, both OUTSIDE the instrumented process, so the test must publish \"listening now\" and the driver must inject; the phase write IS that publication.\n    58\t- The restore book is shared by every session and process (`_journal_locked`); re-keying it must migrate under the same lock and never drop a debt.\n    59\t- A logcat window: `clear_log()` is a device-wide side effect; the bound must be a TIMESTAMP recorded by the owner of the take, not a clear another session could also perform.\n    60\t\n    61\t### 5. Prove the high-risk premises\n    62\t- `insertion api=` is the only insertion outcome line the app writes: `grep -rn 'insertion api=' app/src/main/java` → `paste/InsertionOutcomeLine.kt` (one producer); `grep -rn 'Insertion completed via' app/src` → zero.\n    63\t- `Bound services:{…}` lists every bound service comma-separated in one block (captured above); `label=EnviousWispr` is the app label, so the match is on the label token anywhere in that block.\n    64\t- `ro.serialno` is readable on both devices without root: emulator EMULATOR37X2X8X0 (read 2026-09-22); the phone's is read at `:389` today.\n    65\t- `screenrecord` exists on both devices and stops on SIGINT/kill with a playable file: to be proven in the first build chunk (an unexecuted premise until then; `validation-discipline.md` RULE: an-unexecuted-premise-survives-every-review-that-only-reads).\n    66\t- `am instrument -w -e class …` runs a single `androidTest` class on the emulator without uninstalling anything (the uninstall is `connectedAndroidTest`'s, `device-testing.md` RULE: connectedAndroidTest-UNINSTALLS-the-app-so-never-point-it-at-the-daily-phone); the test APK must be installed once by `adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/app-debug-androidTest.apk`.\n    67\t\n    68\t## 3. Design\n    69\t\n    70\t### Part H, the harness (`scripts/uat/wispr_eyes.py`)\n    71\tH1. **The take's evidence is parsed, not eyeballed.** `_insertion_line(text)` (proposed) parses one `insertion api=` line into `{api, route, written, returned, evidence, outcome, attempts, ms, overrun, target}`; `last_take()` returns it as `insertion` (the stale `Insertion completed via` key goes) and counts `insertion api=` lines in its window (`insertions` (proposed)). `dictate_emulator` and `debug_insert` require `insertions == 1`, `outcome == \"VERIFIED\"`, `written == \"true\"`, `target == target_package`, else `ISSUE: …` naming the field; the route is its own line `VERIFIED: route=COMMIT` (or `PASTE`, still a pass; `route` is reported, never assumed). `dictate_emulator(..., route=None)` (proposed) may REQUIRE a route: `route=\"COMMIT\"` turns a PASTE into `ISSUE`.\n    72\tH2. **The content verdict is exact.** `dictate_emulator(sentence, target_package, expect=None)`: the expected editor text is `before_text + expect`, where `expect` defaults to the literal rendering rule of a plain sentence, `sentence[:1].upper() + sentence[1:] + \".\"` (written here as a literal, not computed by the app; if the app's cleanup changes, this goes red loudly and the caller passes `expect`). The line is `VERIFIED: the same editor's whole text now equals the expectation (N chars)` or `ISSUE: the editor's whole text differs from the expectation; it ends …`. `debug_insert(text)` compares with `before_text + text`. `_sentence_landed` is deleted (its only callers were these two); `_plain` stays for `find`.\n    73\tH3. **Only a uniquely focused editor is a target.** `_focused_field`: `chosen = [n for n in fields if n[\"focused\"]]`; none → `None`; more than one → `Blocked(\"N editors are focused …\")`. `focus_field` already reads back focus.\n    74\tH4. **`bound()` reads the whole block.** `re.search(r\"Bound services:\\{(.*)\\}\\s*$\", out, re.M)` then `\"label=EnviousWispr\" in block`; a missing block stays `Blocked`.\n    75\tH5. **Evidence is bounded to the owned take.** `clear_log()` records the device clock (`date '+%m-%d %H:%M:%S.000'`) in `_STATE[\"log_since\"]` (proposed key); `last_take()`, `recording()` and `_wait_for_the_take_to_finish` read `logcat -d -T '<since>'` when it is set and the WHOLE buffer with `\"bounded\": False` in the result when it is not; `last_take()` requires exactly one `recording_start` in the window, else `{\"unknown\": \"N takes in the window\"}` and the callers report `ISSUE: … UNKNOWN`.\n    76\tH6. **Recording off is `NOT RUN`.** Every report-returning `_recording_is_off()` caller returns `NOT RUN: {RECORDING_IS_OFF}` before staging (four suites, §10); the guard's own two raises inside `open_recorder` stay; `RECORDING_IS_OFF` text unchanged.\n    77\tH7. **The book is keyed by hardware identity.** `_book_key()` (proposed) = `ro.serialno` read once per `device()` into `_STATE[\"identity\"]` (the transport serial kept in `_STATE[\"serial\"]`); `_owe_locked`, `_owed`, `_settled_locked` and `restore()` use `_book_key()`; on first read under the lock, entries under the current transport serial are MOVED under the identity key (migration, never a drop). `restore()` reports which key it paid. `host` stays `host`.\n    78\tH8. **An owned screen recording.** `screen_recording(path)` (proposed) context manager: journals `(\"screenrecord\", pid_or_marker)` BEFORE `adb shell screenrecord --time-limit 180 /sdcard/wispr-eyes/<token>.mp4` starts (background), stops it with `kill -2 <pid>` found by `pidof screenrecord` (refuses when more than one), waits for the file to stop growing, pulls it to `path`, deletes the device file, settles the debt; `restore()` pays a leftover by killing and deleting. `dictate_emulator(..., record=None)`: a host path turns it on; the report carries `NOTE: screen recording at <path>` and the file's size; it is evidence to inspect, never a verdict.\n    79\tH9. **The speaker-playback path is deleted.** `SPEAKER_ACTIVITY`, `stage_phone_speech`, `play_staged_speech` (if present), `unstage_phone_speech`, `say_on_phone`/the convenience wrapper at `:2038-2050`, their shell subcommands and their journal kind; `SpeakerPlaybackActivity.java` STAYS (an instrumentation fixture). `RECORDING_IS_OFF` and `open_recorder` unchanged.\n    80\tH10. **Docs.** `wispr_eyes.py:1406` and `:3139` \"dev state on a phone with no users\" → \"the founder's daily driver; History and foreground state are not restored; never wipe app data or uninstall `com.envi.wispr`\"; `.claude/knowledge/phone-audio-playback.md` becomes a pointer to `device-testing.md` FACT: silent-physical-phone-audio-injection-for-night-uat; the skill's table gains `run_device_test` and drops nothing.\n    81\t\n    82\t### Part T, the device test (`app/src/androidTest`)\n    83\tT1. **`launcherRecordsPhonePlaybackAndReachesClipboardStep` is replaced** by `aSideButtonTakeLandsInTheFocusedEditorExactlyOnce` (proposed): stage `PasteTargetActivity` (field A focused, receipt file cleared by its `onCreate`); register the phase listener; start `VoiceInputActivity` (the side-button stand-in, `android-tooling.md` FACT: driving-the-app-from-the-command-line); await `LISTENING` (20 s bound, the failure names the phase seen); the audio arrives (T2); await the History row's insertion outcome through `observeAll()` (a new row with `insertionResult` in `{committed, pasted}` and `status` final; 90 s bound naming the last row seen); then assert: the receipt file's text `== EXPECTED_TEXT` (a literal, exactly once: `count(EXPECTED_TEXT) == 1`), `insertionResult == \"committed\"` on API 33+ with this field (the route), and `handoff` from the owner's line is not consulted for the verdict (the log stays diagnostic). No polish engine assertion (the emulator has none; the polish limb's outcome is `transcribesThenPolishesWithSavedCustomWords`'s business).\n    84\tT2. **The audio is fed by the driver.** The test takes an instrumentation argument `audio` (`-e audio external|speaker`, default `external`): `external` means the test publishes LISTENING (it already does through the owner's phase) and WAITS; `speaker` plays the fixture through `playFixtureThroughSpeaker` (kept for the phone with no driver present; its `Thread.sleep(clip length)` is the clip's duration, not a settle, and stays). The harness gains `run_device_test(test_class, sentence, ...)` (proposed): installs nothing, runs `am instrument -w -r -e class <cls> -e audio external com.envi.wispr.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner` in the background, polls the surface phase (`run-as com.envi.wispr cat shared_prefs/dictation_surface_state.xml`, a read) until `LISTENING`, then `inject_audio(pcm)` on the emulator (or, on the phone, refuses: the phone's driver is `run.py`, and `RECORDING_IS_OFF` is checked first), and returns the instrumentation's result stream parsed for the runner's status-code lines (`INSTRUMENTATION_STATUS_CODE` (external)) and the failure text. `dictate_emulator`'s 3 s warm-up before injection is kept in the driver (`grpc-take.sh`, 2026-09-13).\n    85\tT3. **The two-editor side-button case (REF-01).** `PasteTargetActivity` gains an intent extra `two_fields` (proposed): a second `EditText` B below A with its own receipt `paste-target-b-received.txt`; row `aTakeStartedInAAndFocusMovedToBLandsInAOnly` (proposed): start with A focused, await LISTENING, `B.requestFocus()` through the activity's own broadcast (`ACTION_FOCUS_B` (proposed), test-package only), the audio arrives, stop; assert A's receipt `== EXPECTED_TEXT` once and B's receipt `== \"\"`, `insertionResult == committed`.\n    86\tT4. **`aDictationWithNoFieldToInsertIntoIsNotReportedToTheUserAsAFailure`** keeps its phase waits (already subject-fired) and swaps `playFixtureThroughSpeaker()` for T2's audio argument; `observedHandoff()` (a logcat read) stays as the PRECONDITION read (it classifies the staging, it does not judge the outcome), stated in its KDoc.\n    87\tT5. **Class declarations.** The rewritten rows are Product Outcome (when they fail, the user's words did not reach the field they were typing in, or reached it twice, or reached the wrong field); `transcribesThenPolishesWithSavedCustomWords` unchanged (Product Outcome, the polish limb).\n    88\t\n    89\t## 3b. Ownership justification\n    90\tNo new owner. The harness stays the one driver; the device test stays the heart's one instrumented crossing; `run_device_test` is the harness driving `am instrument` the way it drives everything else.\n    91\t\n    92\t## 4. Contract deltas\n    93\t- `last_take()`: `insertion` becomes a dict (or `None`); new keys `insertions` (proposed), `bounded` (proposed), `unknown` (proposed).\n    94\t- `dictate_emulator(sentence, target_package, expect=None, route=None, record=None)`; `debug_insert(text, target_package)` verdict lines change wording (see H1/H2); the harness's own tests (`scripts/uat/test_wispr_eyes.py`) update.\n    95\t- `_focused_field` never returns an unfocused editor.\n    96\t- The restore book's keys change from transport serial to hardware identity; existing entries migrate on first read.\n    97\t- Recording-gated entry points return `NOT RUN: …` instead of `BLOCKED: …` (four sites).\n    98\t- Deleted: `SPEAKER_ACTIVITY`, `stage_phone_speech`, `unstage_phone_speech`, the wrapper at `:2038`, `_sentence_landed`, the `speaker` shell subcommands.\n    99\t- `VoicePipelineDeviceTest`: `launcherRecordsPhonePlaybackAndReachesClipboardStep` removed (its protection, \"the launcher path reaches the clipboard step\", moves into T1's stronger row: the editor's text, not a log marker; `testing-philosophy.md` RULE: deleting-a-test-carries-the-burden-of-adding-one); new rows T1, T3; instrumentation argument `audio`.\n   100\t- `PasteTargetActivity`: extra `two_fields`, second receipt, `ACTION_FOCUS_B` (proposed).\n   101\t- The test APK manifest: no new component (a broadcast receiver registered in the activity at runtime).\n   102\t\n   103\t## 5. End-to-end state and lifecycle audit\n   104\tAsync edges for the device rows (`code-design-rules.md` RULE: async-edge-case-enumeration): Interrupted (the driver dies before injecting: the take ends by the 3 s silence bound or the cap; the test's 90 s wait names the phase seen; `restore()` pays the journal) · Deleted (the receipt file removed mid-run: the read fails loudly, not as `\"\"`, because the row asserts the file EXISTS then its text) · Mutated (a second take writes the receipt: `count(EXPECTED) == 1` fails) · Concurrent (two instrumentation runs: `am instrument` serialises per runner; the harness refuses when `pidof` shows one running) · Absent (no History row within the bound: the failure names the rows seen; fail closed) · Stale (an old row: the row awaited must be CREATED after the test's start timestamp, read from `createdAtMs`).\n   105\tFor the harness: the `log_since` (proposed) key unset → `bounded: False` in the result and the verdict says so; a journal migration racing another session → under `_journal_locked`, first-writer moves, second finds nothing to move.\n   106\t\n   107\t## 6. Downstream consumer matrix\n   108\t| Consumer | Reads | Change |\n   109\t|---|---|---|\n   110\t| `scripts/uat/test_wispr_eyes.py` | `_focused_field`, `last_take`, `_sentence_landed`, verdict strings | rows updated; new rows for `_insertion_line`, the exact compare, the bound window, the book key |\n   111\t| `scripts/uat/scenes-115/*` | `dictate_emulator`, `last_take()['ended_by']` | unchanged keys; re-run one scene |\n   112\t| `.claude/skills/wispr-eyes/SKILL.md`, `device-testing.md` | the call table, `stage_phone_speech` | speaker rows removed, `run_device_test` added |\n   113\t| `scripts/uat/silent-audio/run.py` | nothing from the harness | unchanged |\n   114\t| `SilenceStoppedTakeTranscribesDeviceTest` | `SpeakerPlaybackActivity` | unchanged (the activity stays) |\n   115\t\n   116\t## 7. Failure-mode × caller table\n   117\t| Failure | `dictate_emulator` | `run_device_test` | `restore()` |\n   118\t|---|---|---|---|\n   119\t| no `insertion api=` line in the window | `ISSUE: no insertion outcome was logged for this take` | the row's own 90 s bound fails naming the rows seen | n/a |\n   120\t| two takes in the window | `ISSUE: … UNKNOWN (2 takes)` | same | n/a |\n   121\t| editor text ≠ expectation | `ISSUE: … differs; it ends …` | the row fails with both strings | n/a |\n   122\t| no focused editor / two focused | `BLOCKED` before the take | the rig focuses A itself | n/a |\n   123\t| `screenrecord` left running | n/a | n/a | killed by pid, file deleted, debt settled, reported |\n   124\t| `ro.serialno` unreadable | `device()` refuses (identity unknown) | same | pays the transport-keyed book and says so |\n   125\t\n   126\t## 8. Caller-visible signals audit\n   127\tVerdict lines are the signals: `VERIFIED:` only on the exact editor text AND the parsed outcome; `ISSUE:` names the field that failed; `NOT RUN:` for recording off; `BLOCKED:` for a precondition the caller can fix; `NOTE:` for evidence (the route line, the recording path).\n   128\t\n   129\t## 9. Fallback source-of-truth audit\n   130\tThe editor's own text (receipt file on the rig; the tree read on Gmail) is the truth for \"landed\"; the History row is the truth for the route; the log is diagnostic only. Where they disagree the row fails and prints all three.\n   131\t\n   132\t## 10. File-by-file changes\n   133\t- `scripts/uat/wispr_eyes.py`: H1..H10. `_recording_is_off()` callers, enumerated (`grep -n '_recording_is_off()' scripts/uat/wispr_eyes.py`, 2026-09-22): six sites; the four report-returning suites at `:2595` (`dictate_emulator`), `:3176` (`check_recorder`), `:3388` (`room_is_quiet`), `:3438` (`test_dictation`) change to `NOT RUN:`; the two `raise Blocked(RECORDING_IS_OFF)` inside `open_recorder` (`:1674`, `:1741`) STAY: they are the guard itself, and a context manager cannot return a report.\n   134\t- `scripts/uat/test_wispr_eyes.py`: rows per §6.\n   135\t- `app/src/androidTest/java/com/envi/wispr/VoicePipelineDeviceTest.kt`: T1, T2, T4, T5.\n   136\t- `app/src/androidTest/java/com/envi/wispr/PasteTargetActivity.kt`: T3.\n   137\t- `.claude/skills/wispr-eyes/SKILL.md`, `.claude/knowledge/device-testing.md`, `.claude/knowledge/phone-audio-playback.md`: H10 and the `run_device_test` recipe.\n   138\t\n   139\t## 11. Testing\n   140\t1. Classes: the harness's JVM rows (`test_wispr_eyes.py`) are Harness Contract; T1 and T3 are Product Outcome (a user's words reach the field they were typing in, once, and no other); T4 stays Product Outcome; the deleted launcher row's protection moves into T1.\n   141\t2. Two-way controls for the harness parser: `_insertion_line` against the live line captured in §2.5 (parses every field) and against a line with `outcome=UNVERIFIED` (the verdict is `ISSUE`).\n   142\t\n   143\t### 11.1 Hardware UAT spec (emulator)\n   144\t- `dictate_emulator('the quarterly marker sentence lands tomorrow', route='COMMIT')` into Gmail: `VERIFIED: route=COMMIT`, `VERIFIED: … whole text now equals the expectation`, and with `expect='wrong'` the same take reports `ISSUE` (the negative control, run once).\n   145\t- `run_device_test('com.envi.wispr.VoicePipelineDeviceTest#aSideButtonTakeLandsInTheFocusedEditorExactlyOnce', …)` and `…#aTakeStartedInAAndFocusMovedToBLandsInAOnly`: both green on the emulator; the failure control: run T1 with the harness injecting NOTHING (the take ends on the bound) and read the row red naming the phase seen.\n   146\t- `screen_recording` around one take: the file pulled, non-empty, playable (`ffprobe` duration ≈ take length), the device file gone, the book empty.\n   147\t- `restore()` after a simulated leak: start `screenrecord` through the helper, kill the Python process, run `restore()` from a fresh process: killed, deleted, reported.\n   148\t\n   149\t### 11.2 Other obligations\n   150\t| Test | Class | Proves | Revert that turns it red |\n   151\t|---|---|---|---|\n   152\t| `test_wispr_eyes.py::test_insertion_line_parses_the_live_shape` (proposed) | Harness Contract | every field of the captured line | drop a field |\n   153\t| `test_wispr_eyes.py::test_verdict_requires_verified_written_and_target` (proposed) | Harness Contract | `outcome=UNVERIFIED`, `written=false`, a foreign target each give `ISSUE` | gate on `outcome` only |\n   154\t| `test_wispr_eyes.py::test_whole_text_must_equal_before_plus_expected` (proposed) | Harness Contract | a superset, a duplicate, a truncation each give `ISSUE` | fall back to substring |\n   155\t| `test_wispr_eyes.py::test_only_a_focused_editor_is_chosen` (proposed) | Harness Contract | one unfocused editor → `None`; two focused → `Blocked` | `focused or fields` |\n   156\t| `test_wispr_eyes.py::test_bound_reads_the_whole_block` (proposed) | Harness Contract | ours second in the block → `True`; absent → `False`; no block → `Blocked` | anchor at the head |\n   157\t| `test_wispr_eyes.py::test_book_is_keyed_by_identity_and_migrates` (proposed) | Harness Contract | a transport-keyed debt is paid under the identity key; nothing dropped | key by serial |\n   158\t| `test_wispr_eyes.py::test_recording_off_is_not_run` (proposed) | Harness Contract | all four gated entry points return `NOT RUN:` | `BLOCKED:` at one |\n   159\t| `VoicePipelineDeviceTest.aSideButtonTakeLandsInTheFocusedEditorExactlyOnce` (proposed) | Product Outcome | receipt `== EXPECTED_TEXT` once, `insertionResult == committed` | write the text twice; disable the editor write (the row fails even though logs remain) |\n   160\t| `VoicePipelineDeviceTest.aTakeStartedInAAndFocusMovedToBLandsInAOnly` (proposed) | Product Outcome | A holds the text, B is empty | insert into the focused field |\n   161\t\n   162\t## 12. Blast radius & rollback\n   163\tDev tooling and instrumentation only; the app APK does not change (the test APK does). Rollback: revert the PR. Risk: the restore-book re-key touches the founder's phone's journal; the migration runs under the existing lock and is covered by a JVM row against a copied book; `restore()` prints the key it paid.\n   164\t\n   165\t## 13. Ship criteria specific to THIS change\n   166\t- `python3 scripts/uat/test_wispr_eyes.py` green with the new rows, count reported.\n   167\t- The emulator UAT of §11.1, including the two negative controls.\n   168\t- Codex ALL-CLEAR with a confirming rerun; Phase 3 PASS; PR \"Closes #161\".\n   169\t\n   170\t## 14. Open questions\n   171\t- The founder's phone pass: T1 and T3 with `-e audio external` need the phone's driver; `run_device_test` refuses on the phone while `RECORDING_IS_OFF`, so on the phone the rows run with `-e audio speaker` by hand, or through `run.py` once it learns to drive `am instrument`. Deferred to his pass.\n   172\t- REF-02 device rows: not stageable without a seam; #193's JVM rows stand (§2.2).\n   173\t\n   174\t## 15. Related\n   175\t#161 (this), #162 (`run.py`), #177 (one door), #181 (fast eye), #192 (REF-01, the pin), #193 (REF-02), #204, #206; audit `docs/audits/2026-09-20-senior-audit.md` REF-09.\n     1\t# Device Testing\n     2\t\n     3\tThe phone is the only instrument that can answer most questions about this app. **Commands, ADB traps and\n     4\tGradle traps live in [`../rules/android-tooling.md`](../rules/android-tooling.md)** — this file owns the\n     5\tdevice itself and what to test on it.\n     6\t\n     7\t## FACT: the-device\n     8\t| Property | Value |\n     9\t|---|---|\n    10\t| Model | Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, `SM-S948U1`, board `canoe`, SoC SM8850 |\n    11\t| OS | Android 16, SDK 36 |\n    12\t| Accelerators | Adreno 840 GPU, Hexagon HTP NPU |\n    13\t| ADB over Tailscale | `100.94.206.47:5555` |\n    14\t| SSH into Termux | `ssh -p 8022 u0_a517@100.94.206.47` |\n    15\t\n    16\tVerified 2026-08-28. It is the founder's daily driver, not a lab device: restore any setting a session\n    17\tchanges — screen timeout, stay-awake, developer options, an accessibility service enabled for a test.\n    18\t\n    19\t## RULE: recover-the-connection-before-diagnosing-anything-else\n    20\t**Check Tailscale on the Mac first.** `adb connect` AND `ssh -p 8022` timing out together points at this\n    21\tend: `/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale status` (`Tailscale is stopped` is the tell),\n    22\tthen `/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale up` and `~/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb connect 100.94.206.47:5555`.\n    23\t\n    24\tWhen SSH works and ADB does not, three facts decide whether ADB is possible, in this order:\n    25\t\n    26\t| Question | How to answer it | If no |\n    27\t|---|---|---|\n    28\t| Is the phone on WiFi? | `ssh … 'ifconfig \\| grep -A1 wlan0'` | Wireless debugging needs WiFi; on cellular there is no ADB route, whatever the toggle says. |\n    29\t| Is wireless debugging on? | `ssh … 'nmap -sT -p 30000-49000 localhost -T5 --open'`, then `adb connect localhost:<port>` on each | An open port that refuses `adb connect` is not adbd. Only the founder can flip that switch. |\n    30\t| Is the port normalised? | `adb connect 100.94.206.47:5555` from the Mac | After a reboot the port is random again: `adb connect localhost:<port> && adb tcpip 5555 && adb connect localhost:5555`. |\n    31\t\n    32\t`getprop init.svc.adbd` and `sys.usb.config` read as if they answer this and do not.\n    33\t\n    34\t`android-bridge/adb-recover.sh` automates the port loop and must run ON THE PHONE\n    35\t(`ssh -p 8022 u0_a517@100.94.206.47 'bash ~/android-bridge/adb-recover.sh'`); on the Mac it fails on a\n    36\tmissing log path and a WiFi check. If it fails, SSH in, read the port under Settings, Developer options,\n    37\tWireless debugging, and run the port loop by hand. Its pidfile guard is not self-healing: if it answers \"Another instance\n    38\trunning\" and exits 0, read `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` before killing, then remove\n    39\t`~/android-bridge/adb-recover.pid`.\n    40\t\n    41\t## RULE: a-watcher-for-the-phone-names-the-phone\n    42\t`adb devices | grep -qE \"device$\"` asks \"is A device attached\", and an emulator answers yes. Match the\n    43\tserial: `adb devices | grep -qE \"^100\\.94\\.206\\.47:5555[[:space:]]+device$\"`, with a control that the\n    44\tpattern does NOT match while only the emulator is up.\n    45\t\n    46\t## RULE: connectedAndroidTest-UNINSTALLS-the-app-so-never-point-it-at-the-daily-phone\n    47\t`./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest` installs both APKs, runs, and UNINSTALLS them on the way out,\n    48\ttaking app-private storage with it: both models, the history, the custom words, every hand-granted\n    49\tpermission and the saved settings, so ONBOARDING RETURNS. `scripts/hooks/command-safety.py` denies any\n    50\tGradle task named `connected*` and prints the `am instrument` form; an `ANDROID_SERIAL=emulator-*` target\n    51\tstill runs.\n    52\t\n    53\tThe symptom after the fact is `run-as: unknown package`, `pm path` printing nothing, or `am start`\n    54\tanswering `Activity class ... does not exist`. Check `pm path com.envi.wispr` FIRST. Restoring is a chore\n    55\t(twenty minutes, 1.1 GB):\n    56\t\n    57\t```bash\n    58\t$ADB -s $D install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk\n    59\t$ADB -s $D shell 'pm grant com.envi.wispr android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO'\n    60\t$ADB -s $D shell 'pm grant com.envi.wispr android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS'\n    61\t# READ the setting first and APPEND: it is a colon-separated list and this phone carries another\n    62\t# accessibility app; overwriting it turned that one off.\n    63\t$ADB -s $D shell settings get secure enabled_accessibility_services\n    64\t$ADB -s $D shell settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services \"<existing>:com.envi.wispr/com.envi.wispr.paste.PasteAccessibilityService\"\n    65\t$ADB -s $D shell settings put secure accessibility_enabled 1\n    66\t```\n    67\t\n    68\tPass that value as a tool argument, never inside a nested `adb shell '...'` string (quoted inside, it\n    69\tstored `null` and disabled every accessibility service on the phone). Then hand-place the models per\n    70\t[model-delivery.md](model-delivery.md) PROCEDURE: place-a-model-by-hand. All four steps proven\n    71\t2026-08-31. Prefer a manual ADB run for a single question; reach for `connectedAndroidTest` only when the\n    72\trig is genuinely the subject, on the emulator.\n    73\t\n    74\t**`am instrument` is not safe by itself: READ THE SUITE'S `@Before` FIRST.** `AndroidKeystoreSecretStoreTest.setUp`\n    75\tDELETES `no_backup/provider-secrets.v1` unconditionally and `ProviderConfigurationRepositoryTest.setUp`\n    76\tclears the real provider preferences, so either class on the founder's phone destroys his hand-entered\n    77\tkeys. Storage and Keystore suites ask nothing of the microphone, NPU, side button or a real editor: run\n    78\tthem on `emulator-5554`.\n    79\t\n    80\t## RULE: drive-the-instrumented-tests-with-am-instrument-not-gradle\n    81\t`am instrument` does not uninstall, so it is the way to run a device test against the founder's phone:\n    82\t\n    83\t```bash\n    84\tADB=~/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb\n    85\tD=100.94.206.47:5555\n    86\t./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest\n    87\t$ADB -s $D install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk\n    88\t$ADB -s $D install -r -t app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/app-debug-androidTest.apk   # -t: test-only\n    89\t$ADB -s $D shell 'am instrument -w -e class com.envi.wispr.VoicePipelineDeviceTest#<method> \\\n    90\t    com.envi.wispr.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner'\n    91\t```\n    92\t\n    93\t- **Re-enable accessibility after EVERY `install -r`** (it unbinds the service and clears\n    94\t  `enabled_accessibility_services`); set it back, wait a few seconds, never in the same breath as the install.\n    95\t- **Generate the spoken audio with Azure Speech** (`~/.claude/knowledge/ai/cloud-llm-credits.md`, voice\n    96\t  `en-US-AvaNeural`, `X-Microsoft-OutputFormat: raw-16khz-16bit-mono-pcm` is exactly the headerless\n    97\t  fixture format). Write it to BOTH `com.envi.wispr` and `com.envi.wispr.test` under `cache/enviouswispr-uat.pcm`.\n    98\t- **`VoicePipelineDeviceTest` REPORTS THE POLISHED TEXT, NOT THE TRANSCRIPT** (`polishedText` is ASR,\n    99\t  cleanup, then S1-mini). To measure a stage, bind `:asr` directly in a throwaway probe and fail an\n   100\t  assertion carrying `RAW=[...] CLEANED=[...]` (the fixture is our own TTS, so the content rule is not in\n   101\t  play); delete the probe afterwards.\n   102\t- **Parakeet v3 does its own number and currency formatting** (`$37,200`, `64 gigabytes`); never\n   103\t  attribute a formatted number to our code without the raw line.\n   104\t- **Known stale assertion:** `launcherRecordsPhonePlaybackAndReachesClipboardStep` requires `(NPU)` in\n   105\t  the polish log; this phone reports `(GPU)`, so the row goes red after a dictation that worked.\n   106\t\n   107\t## FACT: the-ASSIST-action-opens-a-CHOOSER-on-this-phone\n   108\t`am start -a android.intent.action.ASSIST` does NOT start the recorder on the S26. It shows Android's\n   109\t\"Complete action using\" chooser, because more than one app answers the action and no default is set.\n   110\tFounder observed it 2026-08-30 with the dialog on his screen. Launch the component instead:\n   111\t\n   112\t```bash\n   113\t$ADB shell 'am start -n com.envi.wispr/.ui.VoiceInputActivity'\n   114\t```\n   115\t\n   116\tA missing microphone or notification permission sends that activity straight to Settings and no session\n   117\tstarts, which reads exactly like the launch failing. Check `dumpsys package com.envi.wispr | grep granted`\n   118\tbefore diagnosing anything else.\n   119\t\n   120\t## FACT: uiautomator-dump-crashes-on-this-phone-INTERMITTENTLY\n   121\t`adb shell uiautomator dump` failed on this Android 16 / One UI build on 2026-09-01 with `RC=137` and no XML, logcat\n   122\tpointing at `UiAutomationShellWrapper.connect()`, with or without any accessibility service bound (so not a\n   123\tservice conflict). The same day a dozen-plus calls succeeded, so it CAN fail, not DOES fail: `tree()`\n   124\tretries, and after a second 137 answers `Blocked` naming `shot()`, `overlay()` and `last_take()` as the\n   125\teyes that still work (RULE: no-appium-and-no-tap-by-position).\n   126\t\n   127\t## RULE: drive-the-phone-with-wispr-eyes\n   128\t`scripts/uat/wispr_eyes.py` is the default way to see and drive the app; the one document for it is\n   129\t`../skills/wispr-eyes/SKILL.md`, its own tests `python3 scripts/uat/test_wispr_eyes.py`. Recording from\n   130\tit is OFF for the PHYSICAL phone (`RECORDING_IS_OFF`, scoped by `_recording_is_off()` since #177; the\n   131\temulator records); delete that constant only on a review round whose verdict says the take-with-no-debt\n   132\tCLASS is closed. Since #177 it is the only door: raw driving commands are refused by\n   133\t`scripts/hooks/command-safety.py` (`../rules/tools-and-apps.md` RULE:\n   134\tdrive-the-phone-through-wispr-eyes-before-any-raw-adb). Redirect a long run through `python3 -u`, or a backgrounded\n   135\t`scan()` writes an empty file for minutes. **After `adb install -r`, force-stop through `stop_app()`, never raw\n   136\t`am force-stop`:** a raw force-stop clears the accessibility baseline, `enable_auto_paste()` then journals that\n   137\tcleared state as the debt, and `dictate_emulator()` starts with `restore()`, which pays the debt back and reports\n   138\tauto-paste off (2026-09-20). `stop_app()` journals the on state first and settles its own debt.\n   139\t\n   140\t```bash\n   141\tpython3 scripts/uat/wispr_eyes.py look        # what is on screen\n   142\tpython3 scripts/uat/wispr_eyes.py scan        # every screen, every switch\n   143\tpython3 scripts/uat/wispr_eyes.py restore     # put the phone back\n   144\tpython3 -c \"import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts/uat'); from wispr_eyes import *; print(switches())\"\n   145\t```\n   146\t\n   147\t**Four eyes, and two see the recorder** (measured 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-20, service bound, take running):\n   148\t\n   149\t| Eye | Sees the app's pages | Sees the floating recorder | Cost |\n   150\t|---|---|---|---|\n   151\t| the FAST eye: the app's own accessibility service through `DebugDumpReceiver` (`tree()` on a DEBUG build with the service bound; #181) | YES, every window: app, keyboard, status bar, our bubble | YES: `Recording controls`, the clock, Cancel, Stop, as nodes | 0.1 s |\n   152\t| the SLOW eye: `uiautomator dump` (`tree()` on a release build or an unbound service) | YES | NO, zero nodes while the pill was on screen | 1.9 s, all of it process start |\n   153\t| `screencap` (`shot()`) | YES, as pixels | NO, the home screen with no pill | ~1 s |\n   154\t| `dumpsys window windows` (`overlay()`) | geometry only | YES: `EnviousWispr recording controls`, `shown`, `HAS_DRAWN`, `isOnScreen`, `isVisible` reported separately | 0.1 s |\n   155\t\n   156\tThe fast eye refreshes every node from the live view before reading it: the service's node cache\n   157\treported a switch's OLD state for 1.5 s after a tap (2026-09-20). It reads mid-animation, so anything\n   158\tthat turns a reading into a coordinate reads through `_stable_tree()` (two identical reads 0.12 s\n   159\tapart). Only the shell can ask it (`android.permission.DUMP`); a second debuggable package gets nothing.\n   160\t\n   161\tAsk the tree about a PAGE, `overlay()` about the RECORDER, and the LOG (`recording()` reads\n   162\t`recording_start` against `recording_stop` from `AudioCapture`) about the take. Never tap the pill by a\n   163\tcoordinate: `stop_dictation()` / `cancel_dictation()` use `VoiceInputActivity`'s exported `stop` and\n   164\t`cancel` extras. `dumpsys notification` keeps our entry after the take ends and is not a witness. A\n   165\tscreenshot cannot answer anything about the recorder, including its level meter: the region belongs to\n   166\tthe app behind the pill. Whether the meter responds is a question for a screen RECORDING.\n   167\t\n   168\t## FACT: force-stopping-the-app-CLEARS-the-accessibility-permission\n   169\tMeasured 2026-09-06: a force-stop CLEARS `Settings.Secure.enabled_accessibility_services` (`setting=null`\n   170\tafterwards), so the user's grant is erased and nothing restores it; every dictation then lands on the\n   171\tclipboard. A force-stop reaches real users (app info, a task killer, Samsung's \"put unused apps to sleep\");\n   172\tissue #131 owns the product side. Repair, and read `bound()` back rather than the setting string:\n   173\t\n   174\t```bash\n   175\t$ADB shell settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services com.envi.wispr/com.envi.wispr.paste.PasteAccessibilityService\n   176\t$ADB shell settings put secure accessibility_enabled 1\n   177\t```\n   178\t\n   179\t`wispr_eyes.stop_app()` repairs after its own force-stops; `enable_auto_paste()` is the repair alone. On the\n   180\temulator the repair sometimes does not take (`bound()` False, the setting still `null`, 2026-09-21 #193);\n   181\tthe Permissions page grant flow (\"Agree and open Settings\", \"Use EnviousWispr\", \"Allow\") rebinds it. Deleting\n   182\tthe settings store (`files/datastore/enviouswispr_settings.preferences_pb`, a disposable-emulator staging\n   183\tstep) resets onboarding, and the grant then lives on the onboarding permissions card; \"Set up later\"\n   184\treaches the settings screen again.\n   185\t\n   186\t## FACT: scrolling-UP-from-near-the-top-pulls-down-the-notification-shade\n   187\tA drag that starts in the top strip opens the notification shade, and every later step then reports\n   188\t`EnviousWispr is not on screen; showing com.android.systemui`. Start any downward drag below the top sixth\n   189\tof the screen (`wispr_eyes.scroll` clamps it); `cmd statusbar collapse` closes a shade and is allowed where\n   190\ta swipe at a keyguard is not.\n   191\t\n   192\t## RULE: choose-a-control-by-ANCESTRY-never-by-which-box-surrounds-it\n   193\tCompose puts a row's words and its behaviour on different nodes: `SettingsToggleRow` writes its title into\n   194\ta `TextView` and its state onto the `toggleable` Row that CONTAINS it. Find the words, then walk UP THE\n   195\tPARSED TREE (`wispr_eyes.tree()` records each node's `parent`; `_holder` walks it), never \"the smallest\n   196\tclickable box whose bounds enclose the label\", because an overlapping control gives the wrong answer and\n   197\tthis harness presses buttons that delete a 484 MB model. A flat test fixture cannot catch this; write\n   198\tfixtures nested the way the phone reports them.\n   199\t\n   200\t## RULE: a-change-to-the-phone-must-outlive-the-command-that-made-it\n   201\t`wispr_eyes` runs one process per errand, so the \"put it back\" book is a FILE,\n   202\t`~/.cache/wispr-eyes/restore.json`, keyed by device serial, written BEFORE the change and cleared only\n   203\tafter the restore was read back. A running take is a change in that book, written before the start intent\n   204\tand settled after the microphone closes, so any later session's `restore()` ends it.\n   205\t\n   206\t```bash\n   207\tcat ~/.cache/wispr-eyes/restore.json\n   208\tpython3 -c \"import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts/uat'); from wispr_eyes import *; print(restore())\"\n   209\t```\n   210\t\n   211\t## RULE: no-appium-and-no-tap-by-position\n   212\tAppium left this project on 2026-09-20 (#177): a UiAutomator2 session holds `UiAutomation`, which unbinds\n   213\tthe accessibility service that draws the recorder and inserts text, so every dictation under it hands off\n   214\t`SERVICE_NOT_RUNNING`. The harness's eyes replace it (`look()`, `find()`, `overlay()`, `shot()`), and when\n   215\t`uiautomator dump` dies twice with 137 the answer is `Blocked` naming those, never a second reader.\n   216\t\n   217\t**Never tap a control by position.** A clickable ancestor carries no `text`; the label is in a child. A\n   218\tsession that inferred \"Refresh\" from position deleted the founder's OpenAI key. **Never press Remove on\n   219\this phone unless removing is the thing under test** (founder 2026-09-02); a key is not dev state.\n   220\tRestoring one is possible from GCP (`~/.claude/bin/get-key launch openai-api-key K -- ...`), but the\n   221\tLadder then auto-saves and switches polish to that provider, so the repair changes his settings too.\n   222\t`tap('label')` resolves by words; the Bash hook refuses a raw `input tap`.\n   223\t\n   224\t## FACT: samsung-keyboard-can-float-a-clipboard-suggestion-over-an-inline-button\n   225\tThe Samsung keyboard can draw a floating clipboard-suggestion chip above a focused field when the\n   226\tclipboard holds content resembling what is typed (seen with a password-type field, #62, 2026-09-01). It\n   227\trenders in the IME layer ABOVE the app and intercepts taps meant for an in-field control such as this\n   228\tapp's \"Check\". Dismiss it (tap its ✕) or avoid copying test values to the clipboard. Separately, a raw\n   229\t`input tap` within about 50 px of the right edge can trigger an OS gesture instead; keep synthetic taps\n   230\taway from the outer edge margin, and take bounds from a page source, never from screenshot pixels.\n   231\t\n   232\t## RULE: one-phone-serialises-every-session\n   233\tThere is exactly one device and Codex drives it too. Before a device run, check whether something else is\n   234\ton it — `dumpsys package com.envi.wispr | grep lastUpdateTime` tells you whether a different build was just\n   235\tinstalled. Two sessions installing different builds onto one phone produce results that belong to neither.\n   236\t\n   237\t## FACT: insertion-is-IMPOSSIBLE-on-a-locked-phone-and-here-is-the-proof\n   238\tWhile the phone is secure-locked the accessibility service sees exactly one window, the keyguard, and no\n   239\tapplication window (measured 2026-09-03: `dumpsys accessibility` shows `type=TYPE_SYSTEM` only and zero\n   240\t`envi.wispr.test` windows with the service BOUND and `PasteTargetActivity` top-resumed). Capture, the\n   241\tdetector, auto-stop, transcription and polish all run locked, and a fixture with `android:showWhenLocked`\n   242\tplays audio into the microphone; only the last hop is unreachable. **Read the bound count before believing\n   243\tany window count**: an unbound service also reports zero windows. `dumpsys accessibility | grep -c \"Bound\n   244\tservices:{Service\\[label=EnviousWispr\"` first; a bare re-`put` of the same setting string does NOT rebind.\n   245\t\n   246\t## FACT: a-locked-screen-is-a-real-blocker-not-an-occupancy-question\n   247\t`dumpsys power | grep mWakefulness` reports `Dozing` or `Asleep` when the phone's own screen timeout has\n   248\tlocked it, distinct from the founder actively using it. `KEYCODE_WAKEUP` lights the screen but does not\n   249\tbypass a secure lock; `dumpsys deviceidle | grep mScreenLocked` confirms whether it is still locked.\n   250\tMeasured 2026-08-31: a UAT session's `am start` and tap landed silently on the lock screen mid-run.\n   251\t\n   252\tThis is not the \"never wait for Saurabh\" case in `../rules/tools-and-apps.md`. Check wakefulness before trusting a tap or screenshot, and if locked, report\n   255\t`NEED YOU` and stop rather than sending input into a black screen.\n   256\t\n   257\t## RULE: the-emulator-cannot-answer-the-questions-that-matter\n   258\t`scripts/enviouswispr-emulator.sh` boots an AVD and installs the debug APK.
